plugins.name: ai-era-vulnerability-scanner
plugins.description: Scan a code repository or public-facing website for AI-era security vulnerabilities: supply chain risks, CI/CD misconfigs, zero-trust gaps, secrets sprawl, crypto-agility, LLM/MCP guardrail absence, and observable production weaknesses. Not a CVE scanner.

plugins.name: business-outreach-generator
plugins.description: Generate targeted security outreach emails or LinkedIn messages for small businesses. Uses conditional logic to select the outreach channel, localise content, and inject geo-specific breach examples.

plugins.name: cognitive-sustainability
plugins.description: Apply cognitive sustainability rules to preserve human decision authority and conceptual understanding during AI-assisted development. Use for architecture, security, schema, or high-autonomy coding sessions.

plugins.name: dev-level-up
plugins.description: Repo-aware, language-agnostic scout for cutting-edge developer improvements. Auto-detects or accepts manual tech domains, stores scope in gitignored .tech-stack state, searches primary/community/AI-vendor sources, and scores findings for objective fit, stack relevance, speed, accuracy, capacity, tools, and agility.

plugins.name: city-risk-landscape
plugins.description: Generate an interactive AI-era cyber risk landscape map for a target city. Scores industry subcategories by AI attack likelihood and customer data sensitivity using live CVE research, then renders an interactive bubble chart to identify which businesses to prioritise for security outreach.

plugins.name: optimise-agentic-coding
plugins.description: Analyze a source code repository and apply a systematic 5-layer set of improvements that optimize it for AI agent-assisted debugging. Detects tech stack, installs structured logging, configures MCP servers, sets up agent workflows, and documents env vars.

plugins.name: build-wordpress-plugin
plugins.description: Generate a complete WordPress plugin codebase from a plain-English description. Produces two fully independent build outputs (free .org-clean ZIP + premium ZIP) from one monorepo with zero trialware or telemetry violations in the free build.

plugins.name: business-idea-incubator
plugins.description: Validate, refine, and implement business ideas through multidisciplinary coaching across 11 disciplines (idea validation, marketing, sales, deployment, social media, etc.). Adapts to your experience level and tracks progress.

plugins.name: deterministic-refactor
plugins.description: Plan, sandbox, and execute complex refactors deterministically for senior engineers. Builds a refactor impact tree, records containerized test runs, and applies the final change in one low-risk operation.

plugins.name: detect-codebase-entropy-lite
plugins.description: Free pre-commit entropy scan for staged and unstaged git changes. Detects code-quality issues from AI-generated code — duplication, dead code, test smells, and slop — without security or performance findings.

plugins.name: optimise-agentic-coding-lite
plugins.description: Free single-stack agentic-coding readiness scan. Detects the primary tech stack and produces a 5-layer debugging optimization checklist without auto-apply or MCP configuration.

plugins.name: ai-era-vulnerability-scanner-lite
plugins.description: Free passive scan of one public-facing website or single repo, surfacing the top 3 AI-era security risks and one-sentence remediations.

plugins.name: progress-unblocker
plugins.description: Create visual progress snapshots for a dev task across requirements, design, implementation, configuration, dev testing, and production deployment. Breaks stuck work into smaller parts and prioritises blockers, actions, and completion with unblocking alternatives.

plugins.name: focus-optimiser
plugins.description: Track large sets of related and unrelated tasks, projects, and deadlines as a dependency graph, then prioritise the highest-impact work using the 4 quadrants and other leadership task-management frameworks. Supports a daily focus mode and imports tasks from the Business Idea Incubator and Business Outreach Generator. Visualises status trees and projected timelines.

plugins.name: agent-orchestrator
plugins.description: Prescribe how orchestrator agents should manage tasks and delegate work to local subagents and/or cloud agents using GitHub repos, issues, branches, worktrees, and pull requests with Slack integration for 2-way communication. Subagents run asynchronously in the background by default. Orchestrators manage resources (disk space, RAM, cloud credits), permissions (pre-approved commands, inline scripting forbidden, destructive system commands forbidden, risky git commands forbidden, reusable .sh scripts), state tracking (prevent duplicates, monitor status), helper scripts (poll GitHub issues, check subagent status, cleanup worktrees, long-running orchestration), real-world patterns (worktree isolation, worktree reuse, auth recipes, failure-state propagation, prompt discipline), cloud agent rationing (default to local agents), cost optimization (free Devin models by default), and handle task dependencies and production impact.

plugins.name: upstream-reference
plugins.description: Before designing or auditing critical logic flows (payments, state machines, auth, scheduling, webhooks, sync, retries, idempotency), find mature upstream implementations and align design and tests with their documented contract. Includes a verify mode that audits existing code against an upstream contract.
